tracking: ADR-0331 (lane E13): add-on removal admin routes, raised for the master's review; screen requested on #453

gaps.POST /v1/discovery/endpoint-addon-remova: requests the removal of one flagged MCP server identity from endpoints (endpoint_remediation step-up, then a second administrator's approval; audited; off until the org switch is on)
gaps.GET /v1/discovery/endpoint-addon-removal: lists add-on removals, newest first, with their target counts per status
one add-on removal and its per-endpoint targets with each outcome, code and whether the developer was notified
gaps.POST /v1/discovery/endpoint-addon-remova: cancels a removal: its undelivered targets are stopped and a pending approval is withdrawn; delivered ones keep their real outcome (audited, no step-up)
